body:
Added more tests that you mentioned.

Can't do the closing on toggle button since the toggle button is replaced when the chat is opened. I think we can add it once the design changes are merged.

I also took a look at the shared tests. From what I can tell they rely on widget definitions from IS.js. Should those be handled with the js changes in that case?
Done!
Not having this mock also results in undefined errors in any test file that imports something from instantsearch.js. Do you have something else in mind to have it conditionally mocked?

this seems fine, but you could filter the default tools by the types that are in user tools, or if it would be an object instead of an array, we could loop over the array, use the tool name as the key, and the user tool would override the default tool. 

Either way this already works so that's fine.
Ah yes you're right. Will fix this is the next tools PR that possibly handles more default tools

Should we pass events to `onInput` and `onSubmit`? Currently, only the string value is passed as an parameter
I already fixed it on my PR: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6704/files#diff-a4b4f19ec0ebca80276c69a75834d9570191668718149795eb016789740a4abbR118
what would be the use case, when you don't want to preventDefault?
Let's decide about what to do on my branch
